features.name: share_comments_engaging_op_examples_premises
features.definition: What proportion of counter-argument comments explicitly engage with a specific example or premise cited in the OP's argument text?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users). For each comment, decide whether it explicitly engages (addresses, rebuts, questions, or builds on by specific reference) a particular example or premise stated in the OP's argument text, rather than only giving generic or unrelated points. Read argument to identify the OP's examples/premises. Count only the commenter's own engagement; ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates and reports of the outcome as evidence. Output = engaging comments / total comments (0 to 1). Empty list: null. Malformed/missing input: null.

h0: share_comments_engaging_op_examples_premises has no association with likelihood of view change.
h1: Higher share_comments_engaging_op_examples_premises is associated with a higher likelihood of view change.
note: Operationalized as share of comments (the hypothesis doesn't specify any/share). Comment order and timing unknown; OC_comments and argument text may contain outcome announcements or edits (excluded semantically in the prompt). Association only, not causal.
